Name: Clint's Rock Facts
Author: Willcraftapple11
Description:
Clint now has gift dialogue for every gem and mineral on the collections screen, and lines for when you give him geodes or just a regular. Plain. Ordinary. Stone. He'll even like it!
It makes sense to me that Clint should have opinions about the minerals, and that he should like most of them, so now he does. He also loves a few more things than he does usually, which I'll leave to you to figure out.

Manifest.Name: Clint's Rock Facts
Manifest.Description: Gives Clint gift dialogue for the minerals. Adjusts gift tastes a lil also.
